navIcons.note: Unchanged: 24-box round-join craft nav, bbox/overflow gate D/T/M.

typeSystems.note: Unchanged: six display faces, device-aware chrome.

imagery.note: Vesti coat scaled into the plate with sleeves, notched lapels, collar, welt pockets, buttons, dress-form. Osso slot 2 is a skirt, not a leftover trouser. Crudo plates crop into fanned slices, lemon, salicornia. Atelier cover is a pozzo courtyard, not nested brown rectangles. Still procedural SVG, not photography.

emptySpaceHierarchy.note: Lookbook D/T is a featured garment spanning two rows. Lookbook M sil is 54vh so the coat is cropped, not letterboxed. Magazine D/T is a cover+stack spread. Crudo tickets carry 96–148px plate thumbs instead of 64×52 ovals.

interaction.note: in prova / data-state=on kept. Hover/pressed/loading/empty/success gates kept D/T/M.

nonTautological: GEOMETRIC_REGRESSIONS rejects M250 46l54-16 trapezoid coat, M220 222c44-28 fish blob, nested #c9b496/#6a5e52 photo rects
fashion slot 0 requires data-garment=coat plus lapel, sleeve, seam, pocket, button, collar, lining, dress-form
coat sleeve getBBox width >= 0.92 of body (fails on a tube/trapezoid with no sleeves)
lookbook D/T featured look height > 1.35 × second look (fails on 7c3245c 3-equal-column)
lookbook M sil height >= 40% of viewport (fails on 7c3245c 210px tile)
primary svg fills >= 92% of parent width and 88% of parent height
crudo ticket thumbs min dimension >= 72px (fails on 56px ovals)
crudo hero requires plate + flesh + citrus + herb parts
